headline: Ankle-to-knee prime-angle dribble under onshore wind — marginal at best.
today: SSE prime direction but there's just no size, and the wind goes onshore by mid-morning. Dawn is your only shot at anything clean and even then it's a longboard roll-around. Log or stay in bed.

daysToWatch.note: Small and onshore 16-18mph — junk, don't bother.
Best day of the week. 2.9-3.5ft SSE prime angle with WNW cross-off at dawn and morning. Surf it early before the SW cross-on comes up in the afternoon. Shortboard or fish.
Chest-high prime-angle swell with NNE cross-off all day. Cleaner and worth a session on the shortboard.
